sourceSentences: Recast: Viego hurls a blast of mist in the target direction and dash [dashes] a fixed distance in the same direction, though not through terrain. The mist deals magic damage to the first enemy hit and stuns them for type=channel time seconds.
Spectral Maw Basic attack reset [resets] Viego's basic attack timer. Viego can cast any of his abilities during the dash.
If the charge completes without reactivation, Spectral Maw is cancelled and placed on full cooldown.
Heartbreaker will cast at maximum range from the end of Spectral Maw [Viego] dash if it is cast during the dash.
Viego sends a spectre in the target direction that creates a trail of Mist in its wake which lasts 8 seconds. If it hits terrain, the Mist will spread further around either side.

Harrowed Path can be cast during any of Viego's abilities. Viego cannot gain the camouflage for 1 second if he casts it during Spectral Maw [Viego] channel or starts the channel while Harrowed Path is active.
Spectral Maw [Viego] recast does not incur the 1 second cooldown for regaining the stealth and instead prevents the stealth from being gained until the dash ends
Viego will enter camouflage even while Recalling.
Viego can cast Harrowed Path during the cast time of any ability or spell.
causing him to blink to its location after winding up for 1 second, during which he is untargetable (except to turrets) and lockout [unable to act].
He also gains a free cast of Heartbreaker [Viego], which is initially placed on a cd [1.5-second] cooldown
Casting Heartbreaker [Viego] or attacking a Mist Wraith ends Possession immediately.
The possessed champion's abilities do not cost any mana or energy even if that specific champion normally uses either as a casting resource.
Upon arrival, he strikes the most wounded [Lowest health percent] enemy champion nearby
Other nearby enemies are airborne [knocked back] up to 400-units away based on proximity, though not through terrain.
Viego's next basic attack against a marked target is empowered to consume the mark on-hit to strike a second time
W auto Q is your main trading and ganking tool.
W R is your best long range engage, helping you execute low health enemies and securing a reset.

W auto Q R is your one shot combo, allowing you to burst down enemies with no counter play. It's a true combo assuming you fully charge W and they have no tenacity, meaning they can't flash out of your old if done correctly.
EW is great to catch your enemies off guard.
BE is a combo that not many people know about. It fully conceals your recall allowing you to base on vision and save a few seconds.
You can W into a wall as an auto reset. This is most useful during your clear or when taking towers, but can also be used in combat.
Q flash extends your Q range without delay.
W auto attack Q. And now we take dragon.
For combos, your go-to is the W into E and attack. Q into another attack before ulting and attacking away.
And your go-to gank is to use E into terrain and charge up your W. After landing it, attack into Q, then attack into alt.
If this clients with terrain, it then starts creeping around the entire terrain.
He also gains a free use of his own ultimate which snaps him out of this form.
